description: Assign a channel to a room and/or a function group. Identify the channel by address and the room/function by name (use list_rooms / list_functions to see names). At least one of room or function is required.

confirm.description: Set true to authorize this write against a protected CCU target (e.g. prod). Unlocks writes to that target for the rest of the session.

name: assign_channel
title: Assign Channel to Room/Function
